baseChancePerRewardTick_pct._note: Each rarity is rolled independently per reward tick. A reward tick exists only when the movement gate passes (dungeons.json#movementGate)

quantityPerDrop._source: GDD > Progression > ตัวเลขตั้งต้น > Drop table (Common ได้ 1-3 ชิ้น)
quantityPerDrop._fractionalQuantityRounding_assumption: A-P1-F03-T06-22: after multipliers a fractional Common quantity (e.g. 1.2) rounds up with probability equal to the fraction, using server RNG, so the mean matches the formula. Owner: systems-designer, backend-programmer

rewardTypeByRarity._source: GDD > Progression > วัตถุดิบและการตีบวก (ผงธาตุ Common, แก่นธาตุ Uncommon, หินรอยแยก Rare)
rewardTypeByRarity._assumption: A-P1-F03-T06-8: Common/Uncommon/Rare drops are materials (1 unit each for Uncommon and Rare); Epic and Legendary are equipment of the dungeon's tier. With this reading 12 ticks/h give 1,488 gold/h at NPC prices (GDD: about 1,470). Owner: game-director

multipliers._source: GDD > Progression > ตัวเลขตั้งต้น > Drop table > ตัวคูณ
multipliers._rangedAppliesTo_assumption: A-P1-F03-T06-9: Ranged 'เพิ่มของที่ได้' multiplies Common quantity and the chance of every other rarity; chances are clamped at 100%. Owner: game-director
multipliers._failedRaidWeek_assumption: A-P1-F03-T06-16b: mult = 1.6 + 0.4 x (boss HP fraction left at the end), so a near-kill gives 1.6 and an untouched boss gives 2.0. Owner: game-director
multipliers._lowTrust_source: GDD > Anti-cheat > มาตรการเป็นชั้น > ชั้น 4; threshold lives in anticheat.json#trustScore

smallDungeon._source: GDD > พื้นที่เล่นและ Dungeon > การกำหนด dungeon (dungeon เล็กให้ของน้อยชิ้นกว่าแต่ rare rate สูงกว่า)
smallDungeon._assumption: A-P1-F03-T06-10: GDD does not define 'small'. A dungeon with area below 20,000 m2 (the pocket-park tier) is small. Owner: level-designer

gddReferenceFrequency._source: GDD > Progression > ตัวเลขตั้งต้น > Drop table (40 นาที/วัน: Epic ราว 10 วัน, Legendary ราว 2 เดือน; 3 ชม./วัน: Epic 2-3 วัน, Legendary ราว 2 สัปดาห์)
gddReferenceFrequency._note: Targets for the simulator (P1-F03-T08), not runtime values. They hold at a total multiplier of 1.0. See balance-model.md finding F-2

items._source: P2-F05-T01 · board 1.9 row P1-F03-T11 (dropped items carry assets.icon) · icon ids: art/direction/briefs/P2-assets.md 2.9 (icon-grammar 7.3) · names: config/content/names.th.json
items._note: Catalog of every item a reward tick can put in the run bag. The key is the item id used by dropTables pools, the run bag and the inventory. It is also the key of the item's own table: kind material -> economy.json#npcSellPrice_gold.<id>, kind potion -> economy.json#potions.<id>, kind equipment -> equipment.json#slots.<slot>. rarity = the rarity frame and effect the client shows (frame.rarity.<rarity>-52/72). nameKey = key in config/content/names.th.json (never a Thai string here, CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 3). assets.icon = id in art/assets/manifest.json

dropTables._source: P2-F05-T01 · spec F05 R12, R14 · D-089 · ADR 0003 6.3 (draw order) · tech note F05 5 (rollTickLoot) · keys = drop_table_id of data/dungeons/dungeons.json (FR-11, tools/dungeons build.config.json paths.dropTables)
dropTables._note: One table per preset (data/dungeons/presets.json presetIds). rolls are evaluated in array order. roll 'rarity': chance = baseChancePerRewardTick_pct.<rarity> (common = always, its quantity scaled instead), quantity = quantityPerDrop.<rarity>, multipliers = multipliers.* exactly as in balance-model section 7 (Ranged term on every rarity and the Common quantity; small dungeon by area_m2 < smallDungeon.smallDungeonMaxArea_m2 on rare/epic/legendary chance and the Common quantity). roll 'bonus': chance_pct and qty are its own, no drop multiplier applies (applyDropMultipliers false). Every chance and the always-drop quantity are scaled by f of a D-059 partial tick. The item rarity shown is items.<id>.rarity, or the roll rarity for items with rarity 'byRoll'. Small dungeons get fewer items and higher rare odds from the area rule, not from the preset: every pocketPark is small (size band <= 10,000 m2), a largePark or market is small when its area is below 20,000 m2 (design/levels/presets.md section 6)
dropTables._bonusPotion_source: D-089 and spec F06 section 9 (game-director): potions in every preset's table, about one small potion per 30 minutes of passing ticks, revive potions much rarer, auto-retreat must still be seen in playtest. hpSmall 17% per passing tick = one per 5.9 ticks = one per 29.4 walking minutes; revive 1% = one per 100 ticks = 8.3 walking hours. Same in every preset on purpose (safety does not depend on the place). Evidence: tools/sim report-loop sections 2-4
dropTables._bonusPotion_assumption: A-P2-F05-T01-1: potion rolls take no Ranged or small-dungeon multiplier, so every class gets the same potion supply (GDD Ranged 'more loot' is read as materials and equipment). Phase 2 only: before the Phase 4 NPC shop these rolls must be reviewed, because potion drops lower the potion cost used by the economy target (economy.json#incomeToPotionRatio, HUMAN authority). Owner: game-director
